what: Holiday periods: the days the list is worked hardest. Inside each moment's sale window the calendar sends 2 to 3 emails a day (3 on the peak days), every extra send a promotional one carrying the period's offer. The sale opens lead_days before the moment's own window: Black Friday goes live a full week ahead of Black Friday itself (Nov 20 for Nov 27; Cyber Week, which opens on Thanksgiving, takes 6 so both land on the same day). Extra sends go only to engaged segments: never to a segment whose name says churned, unengaged, lapsed or sunset (no mass sends to the unengaged, the owner 2026-10-05). Ruled by the owner 2026-10-09: "I need 2-3 emails / day go out on holiday periods so we milk the list" and "we need to have black friday go live at least 1 week ahead of time". Supersedes one-send-a-day (2026-09-10) inside these windows only.
